title: GameMaker Library: Quizmaster added, 84 assets
body:
Quizmaster is in the GameMaker Library from today, new here first: it has no page of its own yet. That makes 84 assets on this page. If you own the library, download again from your itch.io library at no extra cost: the whole library holds it in the folder for minigames and game modes, and NEW 2026-11-10: Quizmaster only holds Quizmaster alone, so you only download what changed.

What Quizmaster is

  • A game show quiz for GameMaker in pure GML, written from your own records: register an array of structs (items, monsters, characters, places) and name the fields worth asking about.
  • Four field kinds write their own questions: a number (what does it cost, which costs the most), a category (what element is it, which of these is Fire), a list (which of these is it weak to) and a yes or no (which of these can fly).
  • A question is asked only when exactly one answer is right in your data. Ties, shared names, missing values and answers printed in the question are refused and counted by reason. The test suite re-checks 28,740 written questions against the raw records: 0 wrong.
  • Up to three rival contestants at three levels who buzz in on their own timing, or a solo exam with a pass mark. Lit podiums, buzzers, flip digit scores, a countdown ring, and a reveal that shows the data the answer came from.
  • Six drawn stages and contestants generated from a seed, all drawn in code. No sprite art ships. A runnable demo room, THE QUIZ HALL, plays a show from a sample book of four sets.

It is the third of three Arcade Cabinet minigames, after Pegfall and Schuss.

The library now holds 84 assets worth $1,071.16 bought one by one, for $19.99; 21 of them are minigames and game modes. Every new asset joins on its launch day. Try the free sampler, Drawn in Code, and if the library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

Made with AI tools: the code and the store images.
